description: Second AI-written held-out set, written 2026-11-23 for the abstention milestone. Fresh phrasings, disjoint from heldout.json v1 and from both synthetic splits; the v0.1 model weights and the abstention gate were evaluated on it exactly once. Same honest limit as v1: the author had seen v1's failure analysis, so future iterations tuned on these results turn v2 into a development benchmark too. tier=core: phrasings close to the documented spec that engines should handle. tier=stretch: plausible user wording beyond the current spec; misses here are product gaps, not engine bugs. refuse=true: a correct engine declines.
